scope: AMP authorized fresh local reconstruction pilot, separate from frozen candidate_v6r3 and historical inputs
purpose: Measure executable training-generation-validation path and 200-update throughput before budgeting substantive experiments
evidence_boundary: New experiments on a small filtered public cohort; not reproduction of historical results, not independent antimicrobial activity gold, not prospective validation of old 27 peptides
dataset: DRAMP public snapshot conservative metadata screen, fixed upstream protocol v3, 165 records/164 sequences
split: 149 train /7 validation /8 held-out test; fixed global NW identity70% connected components; all31 historical exclusion strings and their transitive neighbours removed (no eligible matches in this cohort)
features: preprocessing/descriptor_protocol_v2.json; raw descriptors preserved, train-only population zscore fitted in runner
architecture: Retrieved VAE16 latent,48 positions,100 embedding,8 encoder/4 decoder layers,4 additive flow blocks; original global-descriptor abs and padded-index regression MSE plus sampled flow KL/16 retained. Fresh DDPM on posterior mean/logsigma tensor [B,2,16,48], original999-step schedule, new single cohort class.
original_failure: Unscaled historical example forward pass produced infinite/zero Normal scale before backward; retained in runner/forward_check_001
prior_definition: Sample residue-descriptor condition from train uniformly; draw standard normal, invert learned conditional additive flow, decode. This is an empirical condition mixture, not fully de novo descriptor generation.
compute_comparability: Identical train cohort, seed and requested generation budget. VAE-only baselines use the same200-update VAE; DDPM additionally uses200 updates. Markov has closed-form fit and no neural updates. Report parameter counts, updates and measured wall time; do not call these equal-compute comparisons.
model_selection: Pilot fixed configuration established before training; no checkpoint selection by test. Any future validation-informed adjustment must be a named new run. No silent retry or discarded failed attempts.
test_boundary: No test losses, sequence-generation comparisons or activity metrics in this pilot. Partition-integrity auditing may read test membership; distinguish this from test-outcome use. Final test requires a separate configuration/budget/seed/selection lock.
metrics: Execution status, nonfinite failure, validation reconstruction/noise-prediction diagnostics, AA validity and1-48/5-48 length, duplicates, copy, exact global nearest identity, low-order sequence distributions/MMD with fixed train-only definitions. None is an antimicrobial activity metric.
inference: One seed and two samples per method cannot estimate reliable method superiority, confidence intervals, significance or convergence. Samples are not independent training replicates.
acceptance: Engineering gate requires actual finite forward/backward and fresh checkpoint, generation attempts retained, baseline and metric scripts executed, independent review and hash-preserved originals. Scientific/venue readiness remains open regardless of gate result.
